lesson.meaning: The rate at which you or a group can produce good results or complete tasks, especially in relation to the time or effort spent.
examples: Using new software helped increase our team's productivity significantly.
I try to plan my day in advance to boost my personal productivity.
Let's keep this meeting focused to improve its productivity.
The company invested in better machines to enhance factory productivity.
Working from home has actually improved my productivity for many people.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of productivity as how much useful work you finish. The more you get done well, the higher your productivity!
